credit.title: Bubo scandiacus (Schneeeule), call, Zoo Nürnberg (TSA:Bubo_scandiacus_Lue_57_3_1)
credit.author: Hans Lütgens / Tierstimmenarchiv, Museum für Naturkunde Berlin

species: Snowy owl (Bubo scandiacus), a male at Zoo Nürnberg giving its low barking hoots while carrying a mouse
note: From the Animal Sound Archive (Tierstimmenarchiv) of the Museum für Naturkunde Berlin; licence as published for this recording on GBIF and the archive's search site. The 70 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency rumble; the hoots sit at about 200 Hz and above.
